Corollary
[Ergodicity for geometrically tame groups] 1. 9.9.3\group thurston.ch09.ergodicitySource: thurston:page-0294 If $\Gamma $ is geometrically tame, the geodesic flow on $T_1(H^n/\Gamma )$ is ergodic exactly when its limit set is all of $S^2$.
